data.gender_notes: Dun is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Irish and Scottish Gaelic, Dun means fortress or stronghold. This name is often given to children born into strong or protective families. The name Dun carries the meaning “Fortress, stronghold” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Dun usually hope their child will grow to embody fortress, stronghold and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dun total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_english.long_meaning: The name Dun is derived from Hebrew and Greek roots, signifying strength, power, or dark skin. data.cultural_impact: The name Dun has its roots deeply embedded in the rich history of Ireland and Scotland. It is a name with a strong and proud heritage, symbolizing strength, protection, and unity within the family. In these cultures, the naming tradition reflects the value placed on strong, stable, and protective families. The name was often given to children born into prominent families or those who were expected to carry on the legacy of their ancestors.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian faith, the name Dun holds spiritual significance as well. The Bible mentions several instances where a "Dun," or a fortress, represents the security and protection that God provides to His people. For example, Psalm 46:1 says, "God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble. Therefore we will not fear, though the earth give way and the mountains fall into the heart of the sea," drawing a parallel between the fortress as a place of refuge and God Himself. The name Dun can serve as a constant reminder of God's promise to protect and shield His children.
